title: feat(render): froxel volumetric fog
abstract:
## What changed

Per-view froxel volumetric fog. `ViewDesc.volumetric_fog` gives a raster view a 16 px x 16 px x 64 slice RGBA16F volume of its `HeightFog`. `FOG_SCATTERING` fills each froxel with the slice's optical depth and the light it scatters (ambient plus the fog's sun through a Henyey-Greenstein phase, shadowed by the shadow atlas or by traced rays, zero normal so `normal_bias` does not move it). `FOG_INTEGRATION` accumulates each column. The fog helpers read the volume up to `HeightFog.max_distance` and continue with the analytic fog past it, so opaque surfaces, the background, blended draws and refracting readers pick it up unchanged.

- `HeightFog.anisotropy` (default 0.3, validated to |g| < 1); `SkyFogGpu.fog_anisotropy`; `FogVolumeRoot`; `Pass.FOG_SCATTERING`, `Pass.FOG_INTEGRATION`; `LightExtraction.sun_light` and `fog_sun_light` (the atmosphere's sun, else the first directional light).
- Path-traced views fault `INVALID_ARGUMENT` with the switch. A view without it records what main records.
- `sky` example: `--volumetric-fog`, `--taa`, a `pan` preset and segment, anisotropy and `max_distance` sliders. `terrain`, `vegetation`, `water`: `--volumetric-fog` (needs `--sky`).
- Docs: `sky.md` (new section, components, limits, example), `views.md`, `custom_shaders.md`, `benchmarking.md`, `terrain.md`, `vegetation.md`, `water.md`.

## Divergences from the proposal

- The landscape examples print `FOG_SCATTERING` and `FOG_INTEGRATION` in every pass list, as 0 without the switch, instead of only when recorded.
- `--volumetric-fog` without `--sky` returns `INVALID_ARGUMENT` (usage line, exit 1).
- The mutation "clip start ignored in scattering" does not fail its case: the scattering clip start and the division at the plane each give the clipped result alone. Removing both fails the clipped arm. The other nine mutations fail their case.

## Verification

- `python3 scripts/build.py --test`: 30 targets, 1,402 passed before, 1,403 after (one new unit test, four extended). `--regen` leaves the tree clean.
- Render acceptance: 142 cases before, 146 after (four new). On WSL llvmpipe (CPU, headless) the four new cases, the earlier sky cases and the clip-plane, scene-read and custom-shading cases pass, each under 5 s.
- Mutations: ten run, nine fail their case, one equivalent (above).
- llvmpipe smoke with validation, 256 x 144: `sky --volumetric-fog` with atlas, traced, deferred, `--ssgi`, `--taa` and `--path-traced`, and `sky` without the switch, all exit 0 with both gates passing; `terrain --sky --volumetric-fog` passes; `terrain --volumetric-fog` without `--sky` exits 1. `vegetation` and `water` exceed 30 s on llvmpipe and were not run.
- Timings on llvmpipe are environment only; no measured-cost rows are in `docs/sky.md` yet.

## GPU runs for review

In `C:\repos\c3d-review` at the PR head. The before build is main at the merge base.

```powershell
Set-Location C:\repos\c3d-review
git fetch origin
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force build\volumetric-fog | Out-Null
$profile = @("--opt", "O3", "--define", "C3D_PROFILE_GPU", "--define", "C3D_PROFILE_INTERNAL", "--lib", "c3d_profile")
git switch --detach (git merge-base origin/main origin/feat/m70-volumetric-fog)
foreach ($target in "sky", "gltf_viewer") { python scripts\build.py --target $target @profile }
Copy-Item examples\build\sky.exe examples\build\sky-before.exe -Force
Copy-Item examples\build\gltf_viewer.exe examples\build\gltf_viewer-before.exe -Force
git switch --detach origin/feat/m70-volumetric-fog
python scripts\build.py --test
foreach ($target in "sky", "gltf_viewer", "terrain", "vegetation", "water") { python scripts\build.py --target $target @profile }
function Run-Logged([string]$exe, [string]$name, [string[]]$arguments) {
  & $exe @arguments > "build\volumetric-fog\$name.txt"
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output "$name exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
}
$sky = "examples\build\sky.exe"
$landscape = "addons\c3d_landscape.c3l\build"

# Render acceptance with validation, the four volume cases included.
c3c test acceptance --path test\gpu\render

# Validation runs.
$volume = @("--benchmark", "60", "--gpu-timings", "--validation", "--volumetric-fog")
Run-Logged $sky "validation_forward" $volume
Run-Logged $sky "validation_deferred" ($volume + @("--shading", "deferred"))
Run-Logged $sky "validation_traced" ($volume + @("--shadows", "traced"))
Run-Logged $sky "validation_ssgi" ($volume + @("--ssgi"))
Run-Logged $sky "validation_taa" ($volume + @("--taa"))
Run-Logged $sky "validation_path" ($volume + @("--path-traced"))
Run-Logged "$landscape\vegetation.exe" "validation_vegetation" @("--benchmark", "60", "--validation", "--sky", "--volumetric-fog", "--shadows", "traced")
Run-Logged "$landscape\water.exe" "validation_water" @("--benchmark", "60", "--validation", "--sky", "--volumetric-fog")

# Benchmarks, three runs each.
foreach ($run in 1..3) {
  Run-Logged "examples\build\sky-before.exe" "sky_before_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings")
  Run-Logged $sky "sky_after_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings")
  Run-Logged $sky "sky_volume_forward_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--volumetric-fog")
  Run-Logged $sky "sky_volume_deferred_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--volumetric-fog", "--shading", "deferred")
  Run-Logged $sky "sky_volume_traced_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--volumetric-fog", "--shadows", "traced")
  Run-Logged $sky "sky_volume_taa_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--volumetric-fog", "--taa")
  Run-Logged "examples\build\gltf_viewer-before.exe" "sponza_before_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--frames", "300", "--warmup", "60")
  Run-Logged "examples\build\gltf_viewer.exe" "sponza_after_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--frames", "300", "--warmup", "60")
  foreach ($example in "terrain", "vegetation", "water") {
    Run-Logged "$landscape\$example.exe" "${example}_sky_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--sky")
    Run-Logged "$landscape\$example.exe" "${example}_volume_$run" @("--benchmark", "--gpu-timings", "--sky", "--volumetric-fog")
  }
}
Select-String -Path build\volumetric-fog\*.txt -Pattern "^gate " | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Filename): $($_.Line)" }
git switch --detach origin/main
```

Judgement runs, interactive with `--validation`:

- `sky --volumetric-fog --taa --preset pan`: do sun shafts crawl or flicker while panning? If yes, the Q9 reprojection
  trigger fires and reprojection lands in this change before merge.
- `sky --volumetric-fog` at the valley and noon presets: banding along the ground near 200 m (the 128-slice trigger);
  blocky shafts (the 8 px trigger).
- `water --sky --volumetric-fog`: the reflection's fog matches the reflected scene's, with no haze in front of the
  mirror plane.
- Seam at `max_distance`: `sky --volumetric-fog` on flat ground at the noon and valley presets, looking for a ring at
  200 m; toggle the volume on and off on unshadowed haze. A visible ring is a finding.
- Banding at `max_distance` 500 m: the fog panel's `max_distance` slider at 500 in the noon and valley presets.
- Twilight with `--volumetric-fog` (`--preset twilight`): RGBA16F subnormal range, expected clean.

Report, median of three per-run medians at 2560 × 1440: `FOG_SCATTERING` and `FOG_INTEGRATION` per view (sky main and
mirror; water main and mirror) in forward and deferred, and `FOG_SCATTERING` with the atlas against traced shadows;
`FOG` with and without the volume; frame time per segment with and without the switch; `sky` before against after
without the switch and the six largest Sponza passes plus `cpu_record_ms` before and after (equal within the spread);
each landscape example with `--sky` against `--sky --volumetric-fog`; every gate line; the trigger verdicts and the
seam, 500 m banding and twilight judgements. Sum `FOG_SCATTERING` + `FOG_INTEGRATION` of the sky main view at 1440p,
atlas and traced, against the page's 0.5 ms target (exit criterion at 160 × 90 × 64 with a four-cascade sun; the
close-out records 1440p against the page's 1080p). If the traced sum exceeds 0.5 ms or the traced variant costs more
than about 2× the atlas variant, the change returns to the reviewer before merge (Q9). The numbers go into the PR, the
close-out and `docs/sky.md` "Measured cost".

## Remaining work

- The reviewer's RTX 4090 runs above, and the "Measured cost" rows in `docs/sky.md` from them.
- Temporal reprojection or jitter of the volume, 128 slices and 8 px froxels, only if the judgement runs trigger them.
